summary: Guitar and bass amp for a DI signal: a noise gate, one of eight voicings (clean, bright clean, crunch, classic rock, lead, high gain, bass clean, bass drive) built from one to four triode-like gain stages, a passive Bass-Mid-Treble tone stack worked out from its resistors and capacitors, a power stage with Sag, Presence and Resonance, oversampling with anti-aliasing, six cabinets made by our own code (open 1x12, closed 2x12 and 4x12, bass 1x15, 4x10 and 8x10) or any wave of the song as the cabinet, a mic position and cuts, and a tuner that mutes the output while you tune. Use it to turn a clean guitar or bass line into a played-through-an-amp sound.
use_for: Turn a guitar or bass played through a DI into an amped sound: eight voicings from clean to high gain, a tone stack, power-stage sag, cabinets or a wave of the song as the cabinet, a noise gate and a tuner.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: Which side of the interface carries the instrument: Left, Right, or both summed
parameters.how: Chooses which channel of the input is the instrument; an interface's DI is often only on one side. Both adds the two sides.
parameters.sound: Pick the side that has the signal; Both is right for a mono signal on both sides.

parameters.name: Trim
parameters.description: Level into the amp
parameters.how: Raises or lowers the signal going into the amp by up to 24 dB; the meter in the editor shows the level.
parameters.sound: Hotter pickups and louder interfaces need less; more trim pushes the amp harder together with Gain.

parameters.name: Gate
parameters.description: Noise gate threshold; at its lowest the gate is off
parameters.how: Sets the level under which the noise gate shuts, from -80 to -20 dB; the lowest setting is off. It opens at the threshold and closes 6 dB lower.
parameters.sound: The hiss and hum between notes disappear, which matters most with high gain.

parameters.name: Gate release
parameters.description: How fast the gate closes after the signal falls under the threshold
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate takes to close, from 10 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short values chop notes off tightly, long ones let them fade out naturally.

parameters.name: Voicing
parameters.description: The amp: one to four gain stages, its tone stack and power stage
parameters.how: Chooses one of eight amps: Clean, Bright clean, Crunch, Classic rock, Lead, High gain, Bass clean or Bass drive. Changing it while playing crossfades over about 30 ms.
parameters.sound: Clean stays open and glassy, Bright clean sparkles, Crunch breaks up when played hard, Classic rock is full and rough, Lead sings with long sustain, High gain is tight and heavy, the two bass amps stay round or growl.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: Preamp gain between the first two stages
parameters.how: Adds 0 to 40 dB of gain before the later stages, which is how hard they are driven.
parameters.sound: More gain gives more sustain and distortion, and a rougher, more compressed sound.

parameters.name: Bass
parameters.description: Tone stack: bass knob
parameters.how: Turns the bass knob of the passive tone stack from 0 to 100 % of its rotation (a log-taper pot).
parameters.sound: Higher values make the sound fuller and heavier.

parameters.name: Mid
parameters.description: Tone stack: mid knob
parameters.how: Turns the mid knob of the tone stack from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Low values scoop the middle out for a hollow, modern sound, high values bring the mids forward.

parameters.name: Treble
parameters.description: Tone stack: treble knob
parameters.how: Turns the treble knob of the tone stack from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Higher values add bite and sparkle.

parameters.name: Sag
parameters.description: Power supply droop: a slow compressor
parameters.how: Sets how far the power supply voltage droops under load: a slow compression of the power stage.
parameters.sound: Chords bloom and notes swell back after a hard hit; at zero the amp is stiff.

parameters.name: Presence
parameters.description: Feedback shelf for the highs of the power stage
parameters.how: Raises the highs of the power stage (a high shelf around 3.5 kHz, up to 9 dB), the way less negative feedback does.
parameters.sound: More air and edge on top.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Feedback shelf for the lows of the power stage
parameters.how: Raises the lows of the power stage (a low shelf, up to 8 dB), the way less negative feedback does.
parameters.sound: More thump and body.

parameters.name: Master
parameters.description: How hard the power stage is driven
parameters.how: Sets how hard the power stage is driven; the level is made up so it mostly changes the character, not the volume.
parameters.sound: Low values stay clean and open, high values add the warm compression and grit of a power amp pushed into saturation.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Oversampling
parameters.how: Chooses the oversampling of the whole amp: 2x, 4x or 8x, with anti-aliasing curves.
parameters.sound: Higher settings keep the distortion of high notes clean and free of aliasing but cost more processing power.

parameters.name: Cabinet
parameters.description: The speaker cabinet: six made by our own code, Off, or the song's wave as the cabinet
parameters.how: Chooses the cabinet: Off (the amp direct), open 1x12, closed 2x12, closed 4x12, bass 1x15, 4x10 and 8x10, or Wave, a wave of the song used as the cabinet's impulse response. Changing it while playing crossfades over about 30 ms.
parameters.sound: Open-back cabinets are airy and loose, closed ones tight and focused, bass cabinets go deep; Off is raw and fizzy, and a wave puts the sound into any speaker you have recorded.

parameters.name: Wave
parameters.description: The wave slot (1 to 200) used when Cabinet is Wave; the song saves the wave, this only names its slot
parameters.how: Picks the slot of the song's wavetable used as the cabinet's impulse response when Cabinet is Wave, from 1 to 200.
parameters.sound: A short recorded impulse of a speaker or a room gives that speaker; an empty slot falls back to the closed 4x12 and the editor says so.

parameters.name: Mic position
parameters.description: Microphone from the centre of the cone (0) to its edge (100 %): brighter to darker
parameters.how: Moves the microphone across the speaker from the centre of the cone to its edge.
parameters.sound: The centre is bright and bitey, the edge is darker and smoother.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.description: High-pass after the cabinet; at its lowest it is off
parameters.how: Removes low frequencies after the cabinet, from 20 to 400 Hz; the lowest setting is off.
parameters.sound: Raising it tightens the lows and clears room for the bass guitar.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.description: Low-pass after the cabinet; at its highest it is off
parameters.how: Rolls off the highs after the cabinet, from 2 to 20 kHz; the highest setting is off.
parameters.sound: Lowering it takes the fizz off a distorted sound.

parameters.name: Tuner
parameters.description: Shows the note and cents of what you play; mutes the output while on
parameters.how: Switches the tuner on: the editor shows the note, the cents and a needle, and the output is muted so you can tune silently.
parameters.sound: Silence while it is on, with the tuner display in the editor.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: Pitch of A4 for the tuner, 415 to 466 Hz
parameters.how: Sets the frequency of A4 that the tuner measures against, from 415 to 466 Hz (440 Hz is standard).
parameters.sound: No change to the sound: it moves what the tuner calls in tune.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Level of the amp and cabinet
parameters.how: Sets the level in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the amp louder or quieter without changing its character.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed to match)
parameters.how: Blends the amp with the dry input, delayed to match the amp's latency.
parameters.sound: Full amp at 100 %; lower values keep some of the clean DI under the amp.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as shown, 0 % = bypass (the input, delayed by the latency), 200 % = twice the Gain in dB and twice the Master
parameters.how: Scales how hard the amp is driven: Gain in dB and the power stage's drive go with Amount. 0 % is bypass (bit for bit the input), 100 % your settings, 200 % doubles the Gain in dB and the Master drive.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to ease the amp back to clean, up to push it into heavier distortion.
